name: issue-flow
description: Autonomous development loop driven by GitHub or Gitea issues: plan a spec, decompose it into epics and sub-issues, build them with background worker agents on batched integration branches (one CI run per batch), verify the deploy in a real browser, then user-test the result and file what it finds. Four skills, six agents. Everything it writes — specs, issues, comments, manual pages and code comments — follows a Simplified Technical English standard.
